secrets.name: TRANSLATE_API_URL
secrets.description: Base URL of a LibreTranslate-compatible service (for example https://libretranslate.com). Without it the Translate page reports that no provider is configured.

secrets.name: TRANSLATE_API_KEY
secrets.description: API key for the translation provider above, when it requires one. Kept server-side; never exposed to the browser.

secrets.name: TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID
secrets.description: Twilio Account SID (Twilio Console dashboard). Needed only for live automatic texts and calls; without it the Alerts page says the messaging provider is not configured and test mode records what would be sent.

secrets.name: TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN
secrets.description: Twilio Auth Token from the same Console page. Server-only; also used to verify Twilio status and keypad callbacks.

secrets.name: TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER
secrets.description: Twilio sender number in E.164 form (+countrycode...), used for automated voice calls and for SMS when no messaging service is set.

secrets.name: TWILIO_MESSAGING_SERVICE_SID
secrets.description: Optional Twilio Messaging Service SID to send automated SMS through instead of the sender number.

secrets.name: ALERT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL
secrets.description: Public https base URL of this app (for example https://your-domain) so Twilio delivery and keypad callbacks can reach the app.

secrets.name: ALERT_TEST_PHONE
secrets.description: The one phone number test mode is allowed to contact. Without it test mode sends nothing and records the attempt instead.

secrets.name: ALERT_TICK_SECRET
secrets.description: Shared secret required by POST /api/alerts/tick, so escalation can continue with no browser open when a scheduler calls it.
